name: Basic profile
messages: Hi! My name is Maya and I work as a pharmacist.
I live in Denver with my partner.

Which city do I live in?

name: Paraphrased questions
messages: I'm learning Spanish because I'm moving my team to our Madrid office next spring.
My favourite programming language is Rust.

name: Buried in small talk
messages: Ugh, it's raining again today.
Can you recommend a good podcast?
By the way, I have a golden retriever called Biscuit.

Thanks, that sounds great.

name: Several facts in one message
messages: Quick intro: I'm Omar, I'm a high school chemistry teacher, I run marathons, and I'm allergic to peanuts.

name: Moved city
messages: I'm Lena and I live in Chicago.
Big news, I just moved to Seattle for a new role!

name: Changed job
messages: I work as a barista at a cafe downtown.
Update: I quit the cafe, and I now work as a junior data analyst at a bank.

name: Changed preference
messages: I prefer long, detailed answers with lots of background.
Actually, I've changed my mind: I prefer short answers in bullet points.

probes.question: How do I like my answers?

name: Corrected name
messages: My name is Jon.
Sorry, typo earlier. My name is actually John, with an h.

name: New pet replaces old plan
messages: I'm planning to adopt a cat next month.
Change of plans: we adopted a beagle puppy named Pepper instead of a cat.

name: Update keeps unrelated facts
messages: I'm Ana, I live in Boston and I play the cello.
I've relocated to Toronto.
